question: Find the audit report of Apple

result.answer:
Apple Inc.’s independent registered public accounting firm is Ernst & Young LLP, which has served as the company’s auditor since 2009 [1]. 

* Ernst & Young LLP issued an audit report on Apple Inc.’s internal control over financial reporting as of September 26, 2026, based on the 2013 COSO criteria [1][5].
* The audit report, dated November 3, 2026, expressed an unqualified opinion on the company's internal control over financial reporting [5].
* The auditor also audited the company's financial statements in accordance with the standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) [5][6].

We also have audited, in accordance with the standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (United States) (“PCAOB”), the Company’s internal control over financial reporting as of September 26, 2026, based on criteria established in Internal Control – Integrated Framework issued by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (2013 framework) and our report dated November 3, 2026 expressed an unqualified opinion thereon.
Basis for Opinion
These financial statements are the responsibility of the Company’s management. Our responsibility is to express an opinion on the Company’s financial statements based on our audits.

Our responsibility is to express an opinion on the Company’s financial statements based on our audits. We are a public accounting firm registered with the PCAOB and are required to be independent with respect to the Company in accordance with the U.S. federal securities laws and the applicable rules and regulations of the Securities and Exchange Commission and the PCAOB.
We conducted our audits in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB. Those standards require that we plan and perform the audit to obtain reasonable assurance about whether the financial statements are free of material misstatement, whether due to error or fraud.
